deep_analysis:
1 open trade: BTC SHORT 16902 (entry 68002 @23:05, +0.20%, meta_rsi 19.59). Regime alignment: CORRECT — continuum 1m BELOW EMA300 (price 67843 vs EMA300 68564, below for 276 min), trend_quality STRONG_DOWN, 15m aggregate SHORT_BIAS. We are on the right side of the higher-timeframe tape. Two caveats on entry quality: (1) entry RSI 19.59 is deeply oversold — in the last 24h BTC shorts entered below meta_rsi 30 split 2W-2L (16888 +0.19 won, 16886 +0.15 won, 16891 -0.10 lost, 16889 -0.10 lost), so oversold shorts are coin-flips even inside a down-trend; (2) z-score -2.89 STRONG_NEG with acceleration POSITIVE and volume_ratio 3.26 — the tape is stretched below EMA300 and a bounce is the live risk to this short. Auto-trader R1 widened the stop 68361 -> 68551 (risk 0.81% of entry, R:R 4.4 to target 65594); the stop sits above the 68466/68390 rejection highs from the last 6h, so the placement is structural, not arbitrary.

EXIT-CONDITION STEER (re-test next cycle, do not restate without re-reading candles): exit BTC SHORT 16902 if 1m closes reclaim EMA300 (~68564) and hold 15-30m, OR if z-score reverts above -1.0 — either condition means the extended down-spike is reversing and the short's thesis (trend-following below EMA300) is void. As long as price stays below EMA300, HOLD — the trend is our friend and we are on its side.

Wrong-side audit of last 24h closes (8 losers, meta_rsi truth source): 6 of 8 never reached +0.40% MFE — entered mid-chop and died there. BTC LONG 16894 entered at meta_rsi 88.0 in a STRONG_DOWN tape and lost -4.11% — the winning side was plainly SHORT; we bought an overbought spike against the trend. JUP (35.3), INJ (55.5), IOTA (37.5) LONGs all lost into continued dumps — winning side was SHORT or no-trade. MNT SHORT 16890 at meta_rsi 74.0 lost -5.31% — winning side was LONG (the only genuine wrong-side short: shorted strength while the bounce ran). The two armed BTC shorts (16896 mfe 0.78, 16889 mfe 0.87) both reached trail-activation and round-tripped — the winning side there was the bounce LONG after +0.40%.

Portfolio: 1 position, short, aligned with SHORT_BIAS aggregate — no correlation cluster, no stale holds, no trade at 2%+ (no BE-stop action due) and none at 5%+ (no trail action due), none open 8h+. Exposure is thin and correctly sided; the problem tonight is not the open book, it is what we keep entering with.
regime_context: Sources disagree — quote both: 15m regime scanner (regime_5m.json) aggregate = SHORT_BIAS (49 short / 2 long / 78 neutral) while regimes.BTC = NEUTRAL; btc_4h = LONG_BIAS; continuum (1m) = BELOW EMA300, z -2.89 STRONG_NEG, trend_quality STRONG_DOWN, market_phase RECOVERY, acceleration POSITIVE, velocity SLOW. Flip rate is NORMAL, not anomalous: aggregate 20 flips/24h, BTC 24 flips/24h (baseline p50 19 / p95 26) — so no direction-flavored steer can lean on regime stability; every directional statement above is keyed to the condition (1m below EMA300 / z<-1.0) and must be re-tested next cycle. BTC -4.9% in 24h (71333 -> 67843): this is a down-tape, SHORTs are the aligned side, LONGs are counter-trend. Auto-trader independently reads CHOP (long score -30, short +10, MANAGE_ONLY).
